link.1292fd81eee2.source: Memory comes in two tiers. The agent appends raw notes to a dated file under memory/ as it works, then distils the parts that should persist into its curated long-term store, MEMORY.md. By default, MEMORY.md is included in the main session context and omitted from shared or group prompts. This context choice does not restrict access to the file. You will read both straight off the live sandbox a few steps down.
link.1292fd81eee2.value: 記憶分為兩層。代理程式工作時會將原始筆記附加到 memory/ 下以日期命名的檔案，再把應保留的內容整理到長期記憶 MEMORY.md。依預設，MEMORY.md 會納入主要工作階段的上下文，並從共用或群組提示詞中省略。這項上下文選擇並不限制檔案存取。稍後您會直接從執行中的沙箱讀取這兩種記憶。

rich.766fb0c61853.source: The launchable has two planes of authority. The first is the terminal, which runs as the operator above the sandbox boundary and can inspect files permitted to that operator account and list its sandboxes. The agent occupies the second plane. It shares the machine with the terminal but runs under the narrower OpenShell policy tested in Module 4.
rich.766fb0c61853.value: 可啟動執行個體具有兩個權限層面。第一層是終端機，它以沙箱邊界之上的操作員身分執行，可以檢查該操作員帳戶獲准存取的檔案並列出其沙箱。代理程式位於第二層。它與終端機共用同一臺機器，但受模組 4 所測試的、更嚴格的 OpenShell 策略約束。

rich.ca22c0859047.source:
This split matters directly for safety. An agent that can rewrite workspace context can influence later runs. The configured filesystem and network rules determine which other resources it can reach. Inspect the live policy for access to:
  • the host filesystem,
  • the wider network,
  • or a neighbouring agent's workspace.

You will see that boundary tested directly in the next module, where a deliberately over-privileged agent tries to cross it.
rich.ca22c0859047.value:
這種劃分直接影響安全。能夠改寫工作區上下文的代理程式可以影響後續執行。設定的檔案系統和網路規則決定了它還能存取哪些資源。請檢查目前的策略是否允許存取：
  • 主機檔案系統，
  • 更廣泛的網路，
  • 或相鄰代理程式的工作區。

下一模組會直接測試這條邊界：一個被刻意賦予過高權限的代理程式將嘗試越過它。

rich.e2ab07568e06.source: OpenShell is the kernel-level sandbox that holds the agent. For now you can treat it as the boundary between operator and agent that Module 4 goes on to define in full and to test directly. The agent's name in the connect command comes from GET /api/agent, the same call the Kickstart page made to discover your launchable.

text.e54a58a475bd.value: 步驟 2 · 比較訊息指示

text.e984cf5736d2.source: Briefly list the files in your workspace and explain each in one bullet without dumping file contents.
text.e984cf5736d2.value: 簡要列出工作區中的檔案，用一個項目符號說明每個檔案，不要輸出檔案內容。

text.e993aa799509.untranslated: Session-key prefix for the conversation that requests the memory write.

text.ea7fc55bddc3.source:
Ask the same review question in two fresh sessions. The second request explicitly asks for
    an auditor's evidence checks. Inspect both prompts and compare the replies. This changes
    message instructions; it does not edit SOUL.md or route to another persona file.
text.ea7fc55bddc3.value: 在兩個新的工作階段中提出相同的審查問題。第二個請求會明確要求執行稽核人員的證據檢查。檢查兩則提示詞並比較回答。這會改變訊息中的指示，不會修改 SOUL.md，也不會切換至其他角色設定檔。

text.eac85dac0bb9.source: raw notes the agent appends as it works
text.eac85dac0bb9.value: 代理程式工作時追加的原始筆記

text.f1e8d760c12c.untranslated: kept English: product name, code/protocol literal, canonical citation title, or exact interface label

text.f4fba360e86d.source: Review as an auditor: identify missing evidence and ask questions before recommending execution.
text.f4fba360e86d.value: 以稽核人員的角度審查：找出缺少的證據，並在建議執行前提出問題。

text.f505d6caea2f.source: Compare explicit instructions on the same review question
text.f505d6caea2f.value: 針對相同審查問題比較明確指示

text.f70c03689684.source:
Ask the agent to append a uniquely labeled preference to MEMORY.md. An operator read verifies
    the saved reference before a new conversation asks the agent to read it. Acknowledging a save
    is insufficient evidence. The appended note remains available for inspection.
text.f70c03689684.value: 請代理程式在 MEMORY.md 附加一項具有唯一標籤的偏好設定。先透過操作介面讀取檔案，確認儲存的參考碼，再於新對話中請代理程式讀取。僅聲稱已儲存並不足以作為證據。附加的筆記會保留供您檢查。
